en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1.  It  is  narrated that Imam  Zainul Abideen (a.s.)  said that Allah,  the  Mighty  and  Sublime  says,

“ (I  swear)  by  My Honor, Greatness, Beauty, Strength and high-rank, one who gives preference to My pleasure over his desires I will fulfill the aim of his hereafter. I will make his heart self-sufficient, earth and heavens are guarantors of his sustenance and he will get worldly wealth even without desiring it.”
